question: The Third Five-Year Plan of India was launched under the leadership of __ __ .
solution:
The correct answer is **'Jawaharlal Nehru'. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• ​Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru oversaw the **1961–1966** implementation of the third Five Year Plan.
 
• **D. R. Gadgil **served as the Planning Commission's deputy chairman throughout the third five-year plan's development. The Gadgil Yojana was another name for the programme.
 
• In April 1961, INDIA unveiled its** Third Five-Year Plan for economic growth**.
 
• The development effort started ten years ago is intended to be advanced by one level with this plan.
 
• Given the anticipated population expansion over the next 15 years, this economic planning aims to raise the income level of the Indian population by **100%**.
